nodes.description: State variable 'owner' in contract Owned; holds the current owner address.
State variable 'newOwner' in contract Owned; holds the pending owner address for two-step ownership transfer.
Public state variable 'symbol' of DelightToken, set to "DLT" in constructor.
Public state variable 'name' of DelightToken, set to "DelightToken" in constructor.
Public state variable 'decimals' of DelightToken, set to 8 in constructor.
Public state variable '_totalSupply' of DelightToken, set to 1500000000000000000 in constructor.
Mapping address => uint holding token balances of DelightToken.
Nested mapping (owner => spender => uint) holding ERC20 allowances of DelightToken.
SafeMath.safeAdd: computes c = a + b and requires c >= a to detect overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub: requires b <= a, computes c = a - b to detect underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul: computes c = a * b and requires a == 0 || c / a == b to detect overflow.
SafeMath.safeDiv: requires b > 0 and computes c = a / b.
Constructor of contract Owned; assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Owned.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership: requires msg.sender == newOwner and finalizes ownership transfer.
DelightToken constructor; initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-funds the deployer address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)], i.e. circulating supply.
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
ERC20 transfer: debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
ERC20 transferFrom: debits balances[from], reduces allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to].
Returns remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner from the allowed mapping.
Sets allowance then makes an external call to spender.receiveApproval, enabling a callback path.
Payable fallback function of DelightToken that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
onlyOwner function that performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract to rescue tokens to owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance debits, allowances and access control checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed after state update; reentrancy vector.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an attacker-supplied token address.
Unchecked arithmetic addition c = a + b inside safeAdd; overflow protection relies on the following require.
Unchecked arithmetic subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub; underflow protection relies on the preceding require.
Unchecked arithmetic multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul; overflow protection relies on the following require.

Second parameter 'b' of safeAdd.
Return variable 'c' of safeAdd holding the sum.
First parameter 'a' of safeSub.
Second parameter 'b' of safeSub.
Return variable 'c' of safeSub holding the difference.

Second parameter 'b' of safeMul.
Return variable 'c' of safeMul holding the product.
First parameter 'a' of safeDiv (dividend).
Second parameter 'b' of safeDiv (divisor, required > 0).
Return variable 'c' of safeDiv holding the quotient.
Parameter '_newOwner' of transferOwnership, written into the newOwner state variable.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf used as the balances mapping key.
Parameter 'to' of transfer, recipient credited with tokens.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer, amount debited from the caller.
Parameter 'spender' of approve, allowance recipient.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve, allowance amount.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom, account debited.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom, account credited.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom, amount moved.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of allowance, allowance owner.
Parameter 'spender' of allowance, allowance spender.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall; also the callee address of the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall, allowance amount.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall, arbitrary bytes forwarded to the external callee.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' of transferAnyERC20Token; arbitrary contract addressed by the external call.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferAnyERC20Token, amount transferred out to owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the Owned constructor, granting ownership to the caller.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before completing the ownership handover.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender], the caller-controlled balance slot.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address as the owner key.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller as the spender key.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external callee.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted to the owner, i.e. the address that satisfied msg.sender == owner.
Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied _newOwner into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner, changing privileged control of the token contract.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the ownership handover.
DelightToken constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
DelightToken constructor initializes the name state variable.
DelightToken constructor initializes the decimals state variable.
DelightToken constructor sets the total token supply in _totalSupply.
DelightToken constructor pre-funds the deployer address in the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] which is subtracted from _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the requested tokenOwner.
transfer debits and credits entries of the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom decrements the allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance entry.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for tokenOwner and spender.
approveAndCall writes the allowed allowance mapping before the external callback.
transferAnyERC20Token directs rescued tokens to the owner state variable address.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the from balance and the allowance.
safeAdd performs the unchecked addition c = a + b before the overflow require, the arithmetic-sensitive operation of the function.
safeSub performs the unchecked subtraction c = a - b, relying on the preceding require to prevent underflow.
safeMul performs the unchecked multiplication c = a * b before the overflow require.
approveAndCall invokes an external contract through receiveApproval, transferring control to untrusted code.
The spender contract's receiveApproval callback re-enters the DelightToken contract while state has already been updated.
The allowed allowance state is written before the external receiveApproval call, allowing reentrant interaction with allowances.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an owner-supplied arbitrary token contract.

Parameter 'spender' of allowance is the second key of the allowed mapping.
